run_multi_turn_conversation: run a multi-turn question conversation with SGL function and OpenAI o1 backend
run_batch_conversations: run a batch of multi-turn conversations with different question pairs
retrieve_conversation_messages: retrieve all role/content messages from a multi-turn conversation state
access_generation_variable: access a named generation variable like answer_1 from a conversation state
set_openai_backend: set the default SGL backend to OpenAI with the o1 model
